title: console: hosted-shape browser pass 2026-10-12 — 7 P3 defects (report group order, FAB over save/delete, stale rollup after child edit, links without /_console, comments without edit/reply, generic flow toast, raw ids in right rail) — list card, split per item at dispatch
body:
Filing gate ①: reproduced product defects, folded into one list card per the filing gate's quota. Each item has its own measured `reach:`. Filed under the maintainer's direct instruction in this session (2026-10-12: 「你测试遇到的问题创建issue」, then 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能创建 issue」).
Reader: objectui triage (routing to the `domain:ui` lane), split per item at dispatch.

Dedupe (REST search, all states):

| item | query | hits | nearest |
|:--|:--|--:|:--|
| 1 | `report group order alphabetical` | 7 | #11809 (closed; its fix is in the pin but does not cover report tables) |
| 1 | `report table grouping option order` | 62 | — |
| 2 | `floating assistant button covers` | 2 | #10899 (closed: the FAB over the chat send button) |

| 3 | `header total stale related list` | 150 | none on point in the first page |

| 5 | `comment edit delete reply` | 127 | none on point in the first page |
| 6 | `flow action successMessage` | 12 | #12075 (open: flow toast translation keys; related, not the same) |
| 7 | `related summary raw id` | 196 | #12188 (closed: `[object Object]` at phone width) |

**Source.** 2026-10-12 hosted-shape browser pass of HotCRM 4.0.1 on a cloud rig at production v1.36.0's pins (objectui `d758f2f20d`), zh-CN, Asia/Taipei. The P2 objectui findings from the same pass are on their own cards: #12205 and #12206. #12207 was closed as a duplicate of #12105. The re-measurement of #7205 is on #7205.

## Items

### 1. Report tables group a select field by its raw value, so stages and statuses come out alphabetical
- **Reach:** reports Opportunities by Stage, Opportunity Funnel by Owner → Stage, and Cases by Status and Priority.
- **What happens:**
  - Rows read 成交, 需求分析, 谈判, 提案, 寻找客户, 资格审查. That is the alphabetical order of `closed_won, needs_analysis, negotiation, proposal, prospecting, qualification`.
  - Cases read 已关闭, 已升级, 处理中, 新建, … (alphabetical by key).
  - The bar chart in Opportunities by Stage follows the same order. The Funnel report's chart is ordered correctly; its table is not.
  - #11809's fix (PR #11830, merged 2026-10-07) is in the pin, so this is a surface that fix did not cover.
- **Acceptance:** report table rows (and their charts) follow the field's declared option order.

### 2. The floating assistant button covers the inline-edit 保存 and the attachment 删除附件 buttons; attachment delete has no confirmation
- **Reach:** case and task record, viewport 1440×900 and 1440×1400.
  - `document.elementFromPoint` at the centre of 保存 (1365,849) and of 删除附件 (1383,847) returns the assistant button `打开HotCRM助手`. A click opens the assistant instead.
  - One tester lost an inline save this way.
  - The delete button is only reachable by keyboard (Tab from 下载, then Enter), and it deletes at once: `DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_attachment/…` → 200, with no confirm.
- **Acceptance:**
  - Neither button sits under the FAB at common viewports. For example, the FAB yields while an inline-edit bar or a row action is in its corner.
  - Attachment delete asks for confirmation.

### 3. Quote header 总金额 stays stale after line items change, until a full reload
- **Reach:** QTE-0007 → 相关 → edit a line's quantity, then delete a line.
  - The server recalculates (`total_price` 11430, then 9000), but the header keeps showing 9,810.00, even after 3 s.
  - Only a browser reload shows 9,000.00.
  - Measured 2 of 2.
- **Acceptance:** a write to a child in a related list refreshes the parent record's displayed rollups.

### 4. Lookup links on record pages have hrefs without `/_console`
- **Reach:** the 转化 section links (account, contact) and the owner (sys_user) links on a lead page.
  - The href is `…:5650/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_account/record/<id>?from=…`, missing `/_console`.
  - A left-click works because the SPA router intercepts it.
  - Open-in-new-tab, middle-click or a copied link lands on a page whose whole body is `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found"}}`. The direct open was measured once; the bad hrefs were seen on account, contact and user links.
- **Acceptance:** record-page lookup links carry the console base path.

### 5. Comments cannot be edited, deleted or replied to
- **Reach:** CASE-00041 (活动) and KA-0005 (讨论).
  - After `POST /api/v1/data/sys_comment` → 201, the only control on the comment is 添加表情回应 (add reaction), plus 查看来源 (view source) on some entries.
  - `case_detail_page`'s `record:activity` sets `enableThreading: true`, yet there is no reply.
  - Measured 2 of 2.
- **Acceptance:** an author can edit and delete their own comment, and replies render where threading is enabled. If threading is not supported, the prop should say so.

### 6. Flow-backed action toasts show 「流程「…」已完成」 instead of the action's `successMessage`
- **Reach:**
  - 升级工单, 关闭工单 and 认领工单 show 「流程「升级工单」已完成」 and so on.
  - Script actions such as 记录通话 do show their own `successMessage` (「通话记录成功！」).
  - Measured 3 of 3.
- **Acceptance:** an action-door flow launch shows the action's declared `successMessage` when one is set.

### 7. The opportunity right-rail related summary lists line items by raw record id
- **Reach:**
  - Opportunity "Wayne Enterprise License" → right rail 商机产品明细 (3) shows `Qr9tmsxIhxo_6FEy`, `fYVV00ZGOAMUl4EK` and `seoqWJ0504iRXfaj`.
  - The main related list names them by product ("PRD-0005 - AI Agent Seat (Annual)").
  - Seen on two loads.
- **Acceptance:** the right-rail summary resolves the same display name as the related list.
